12class UserObserver
13{
14    /**

16     */
17    public function created(User $user): void
18    {
19        // Create admin personal folders for all mailboxes
20        if ($user->isAdmin()) {
21            $this->createAdminPersonalFolders($user);
22        }
23
24        // Add default subscriptions

28    /**
29     * Handle the User "deleting" event.
30     */
31    public function deleting(User $user): void
32    {
33        // Delete user's personal folders
34        $user->folders()->delete();
35
36        // Remove from conversation followers
37        $user->followedConversations()->detach();
38
39        // Unassign from conversations (set user_id to null)
40        $user->conversations()->update(['user_id' => null]);
41
42        // Dispatch UserDeleted event
43        // Note: We pass the user as both deleted_user and by_user (assuming self-delete or system delete)
44        // In a real controller, by_user would be the authenticated user
45        \App\Events\UserDeleted::dispatch($user, $user);

48    /**

52    {
